dinamikQr.aciklama: Create QR codes and short links whose destination you can change later, and track scans by country and device.
dinamikQr.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own QR codes and short links, plus every record created by clients. You can block an abused record from here.
dinamikQr.bos: No QR codes or short links yet. Create your first one.

turAciklama.url: Redirects to a web page; UTM tags can be added.
turAciklama.google_yorum: Takes your customer straight to the Google review form.
turAciklama.whatsapp: Opens a WhatsApp chat with a ready-made message.
turAciklama.telefon: Starts a call with one tap.
turAciklama.eposta: Opens an email with the subject and text filled in.
turAciklama.sms: Opens an SMS with ready-made text.
turAciklama.konum: Shows a location or address on Google Maps.
turAciklama.vcard: Saves a contact card to the phone's address book.
turAciklama.etkinlik: Adds the event to the calendar (.ics).
turAciklama.uygulama: Sends iPhones to the App Store and Android to Google Play.
turAciklama.wifi: Joins the network without typing a password (static).
turAciklama.kisa_link: A shareable short link, without a QR image.

ipucu.numara: Include the country code: +905551112233. Spaces and dashes are removed automatically.
ipucu.placeBaslik: How do I find the Place ID?
ipucu.placeMetin: Open Google's official Place ID Finder, search for your business name and paste the "Place ID" value from the pop-up (it usually starts with ChIJ) here. Customers who scan the QR go straight to the review form.
ipucu.uygulama: Enter at least one link. iPhones go to the App Store, Android to Google Play and other devices to the "other" URL; if one is missing, the first available link is used.
ipucu.vcard: At least a first name, last name or organisation is required. When scanned, the phone offers to save the contact.
ipucu.wifi: A Wi-Fi QR is static: the network details are written into the QR itself, cannot be changed later and scans cannot be counted.

utm.aciklama: Add source, medium and campaign tags so your analytics tool (Google Analytics etc.) shows that the traffic came from this QR.

sihirbaz.dinamikBilgi: Dynamic QR: the QR only contains a short address. You can change the destination at any time; the printed QR stays the same and scans are counted.
sihirbaz.statikBilgi: Static QR: the data is written directly into the QR. Changing it later means printing a new QR; scans cannot be counted.
sihirbaz.kisaLinkBilgi: Short link: a short address you can share, without a QR image. You can change the destination later and track clicks.

tasarim.logoH: Because a logo is added, error correction is kept at the highest level (H).
tasarim.logoBilgi: Centre logo: PNG or JPG, up to {{kb}} KB. A simple, square logo works best.

uyari.dusuk_kontrast: Low colour contrast ({{oran}}:1). Some phones may not read this QR; a dark foreground on a light background is recommended.
uyari.ters_renk: The foreground is lighter than the background (inverted). Many readers do not recognise inverted QR codes.
uyari.dar_kenar: The quiet zone is narrow. Leave at least 2, ideally 4 modules for reliable scanning.

ayarlar.takmaAdBilgi: A second, easy-to-share address. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; it does not change the QR image.
ayarlar.aktif: Active (when off, people who scan it see a "link not active" page)
ayarlar.hesap: Create on behalf of a client (optional)
ayarlar.hesapBilgi: Leave empty to make it the agency's own record.
ayarlar.statikNot: End date, scan limit and alias do not apply to static QR codes.

liste.kopyalanamadi: Could not copy; please select and copy the address manually.

ayrinti.silOnay: Delete "{{ad}}"? The printed QR will stop working (the record can be restored from the trash).
ayrinti.engelliBilgi: This record has been blocked by the agency for misuse. People who scan it see a "link not active" page.

analiz.botBilgi: Bots and link previews are not counted ({{sayi}} filtered out).
analiz.grafikEtiket: {{sayi}} scans in the last {{gun}} days, daily bar chart
analiz.statikBilgi: Static QR codes (Wi-Fi, plain text) carry the data directly, so their scans cannot be counted.

toplu.aciklama: Create up to {{satir}} records at once from a CSV file (max {{kb}} KB). Rows are checked first and errors are shown; only valid rows are created.
toplu.sutunlar: Required columns: ad (name), tur (type). Put the destination in a "hedef" column (URL, Place ID, phone number, email, address or "lat,lng", Wi-Fi network name). Optional: mesaj, konu, govde, sifre, guvenlik, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, takma_ad, kisa_link. Comma or semicolon separators both work.

hata.sema_izinsiz: This kind of address is not allowed. Only addresses starting with http:// or https:// are accepted.
hata.dongu: A short address cannot redirect to another short address.
hata.place_id_gecersiz: The Place ID looks invalid (it usually starts with ChIJ…).
hata.telefon_gecersiz: Enter the number with its country code (e.g. +905551112233).
hata.bitis_once: The end cannot be before the start.
hata.sifre_gecersiz: A WPA Wi-Fi password must be 8–63 characters.
hata.aralik_disi: The value must be between {{en_az}} and {{en_cok}}.
hata.logo_gecersiz: The logo could not be read. Try another PNG or JPG.
hata.logo_turu: The logo must be a PNG or JPG.
hata.logo_buyuk: The logo can be at most {{en_cok_kb}} KB.
hata.logo_boyutu: The logo is too small or too large.
hata.veri_cok_uzun: The content is too long to fit in a QR code. Shorten the text.
hata.veri_gecersiz: A QR code could not be generated from this content.
hata.takma_ad_gecersiz: The alias must be 3–40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
hata.takma_ad_ayrilmis: This alias is reserved; choose another.
hata.takma_ad_kullaniliyor: This alias is already in use; choose another.
hata.kisa_link_yalniz_url: Short links are only available for the website type.
hata.kayit_siniri: Record limit reached (max {{sinir}}). Delete one or contact the agency to add more.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many actions in a short time. Please try again in a minute.
hata.modul_kapali: This module is not enabled for your account.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: You do not have permission for this section.
hata.hesap_uyesi_degil: You do not have access to this account.
hata.oturum_gerekli: Your session has expired; please sign in again.
hata.dosya_buyuk: The file is too large (max {{en_cok_kb}} KB).
hata.baslik_eksik: The first row of the CSV must contain the "ad" and "tur" columns.
hata.cok_satir: At most {{en_cok}} rows can be uploaded at once.
hata.csv_bozuk: The CSV file could not be read.
hata.satir_yok: There are no rows to create.
hata.hedef_gecersiz: The destination address is not safe.
hata.kod_uretilemedi: A code could not be generated; please try again.
hata.cakisma: The record clashed with another; please try again.
hata.ag: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
hata.genel: Something went wrong. Please try again.
